definitions.name: word-length Dirichlet form
definitions.statement: π uniform probability on Z_n; ψ_n(k)=min(k,n−k), E_n(f)=Σ ψ_n(k)|fhat(k)|², n≥4. Product generator A=Σ_i Aψn^(i); 0log0=0.

theorem_cards.label: Theorem 5 (quartic stability)
assumptions: Word-length Poisson generator, not unnormalized nearest-neighbor Laplacian
theorem_cards.statement: 2∫fAf dμ−Entμ(f²)≥(12d)^−1 ||f−1||_L2(μ)^4. Exponent4 and d^-1 order optimal; coefficient1/12 not claimed optimal.
proof_steps: Cubic-majorant remainder R(t)≥(t−1)^4/(6max(1,t²)); normalized Cauchy–Schwarz plus ∫max(1,f²)≤2 gives ∫R(f)≥||f−1||²_2²/12.
Cubic criterion follows from mean-zero third-moment π(u³)≤3S²Q; source counts odd/even Fourier resonances separately and retains self-conjugate even middle frequency.

Product proof forms f_i=(E_{x1,...,xi}f²)^1/2; entropy telescopes, slice unnormalized stability handles f_i=0 by zero convention. Norm contraction controls sliced energy, Jensen+Cauchy–Schwarz across d coordinates gives factor1/d.
Perturbation gε=(1+εv)/√(1+ε²), v first eigenfunction, then product Fε=Π gε; ratio deficit/distance^4→(3+πv^4)/(6d).
gaps: Formal Lean repository reported for Theorem1 is not itself checked here.
Small ε product asymptotics are first ε→0 for fixed d; O_d constants do not certify uniform d→∞ expansion.

theorem_cards.label: Theorem 4 (circle)
proof_steps: Direct finite Fourier third-moment estimate for trigonometric polynomials.
Positive Fejér approximants f_N→f inL², E(f_N)→E(f); entropy uses lower semicontinuity after f_N²→f² inL¹.
gaps: Pointwise convergence of Fourier multipliers alone would not justify arbitrary-function limit; source supplies approximation and lsc.

constant_dependence.explicit: LS constant2 uniform n≥4 and dimension via tensorization; stability coefficient1/(12d), numerical1/12 not sharp-certified; exponent4 locally optimal.
constant_dependence.quantifiers: Sharp order d^-1 shown by ε→0 separately at each fixed d; no dimension-independent positive coefficient possible.

endpoint_limits.scope: n=3 excluded; stability stated for nonnegative f and normalizedL2. Complex functions have LS by modulus contraction, not this exact ||f−1|| stability without quotienting phase.
endpoint_limits.not_established: No direct maximal-cube stability or phase-invariant complex stability statement.

reusable_methods.method: Use exact remainder beyond a sharp pointwise majorant
